_about: BAA status per vendor, for the PHI-restricted mode (issue #890). On a PHI-restricted device nothing is sent to a vendor whose status here is not 'confirmed'. A blank, missing or unrecognised row is BLOCKED, not allowed - that is the whole point of the rule. Confirmations are Joe's to record; nothing else may write this file. See windows/VENDOR-BAA-STATUS.md for what each vendor receives.
_values: confirmed | unconfirmed. Anything else reads as unconfirmed.
